templates.name: Aave V3 Origin
templates.description: Reference codebase of Aave V3 pooled money markets with eMode, isolation mode, supply caps and the full configurator stack.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1 (change date earlier of 2027-03-06 or ENS record, restrictive anti fork use grant)
templates.audited: Yes, OpenZeppelin, Trail of Bits, ABDK, PeckShield, SigmaPrime, Certora
templates.robinhood_note: No Robinhood entry in the official bgd-labs aave-address-book (AaveV3Arbitrum present)
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: License forbids competing forks; asset listing needs Aave governance so new tokens are unrealistic

templates.name: Ajna Protocol
templates.description: Oracle free lending where lenders pick price buckets and anyone can deploy a pool for any ERC-20 or NFT collateral through the pool factory.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1 (change date 2026-04-01 has passed, change license to be a GPL-2.0 compatible license; interfaces MIT)
templates.audited: Yes, Sherlock, Certora, Prototech, Trail of Bits, Code4rena, Quantstamp
templates.robinhood_note: No Robinhood deployment found; license grant lets third parties deploy unmodified code if bwAJNA is bridged first
templates.pons_fit: Strong fit since no oracle is needed, so a Pons token and USDG pool can launch right away and price risk is set by lenders.
templates.notes: Third party chain deploy allowed only with unmodified code and bridged bwAJNA; verify current LICENSE before forking

templates.name: Chainlink Data Feeds (incl. stock token feeds)
templates.description: Aggregator contracts that publish signed price data on chain, plus an L2 sequencer uptime feed, used by lending markets for collateral valuation.
templates.license: MIT for most contracts; CCIP and some workflow code BUSL-1.1
templates.audited: Yes, multiple external audits per Chainlink
templates.robinhood_note: Chainlink changelog July 1 2026 says Data Feeds are live on Robinhood Chain Mainnet; Robinhood docs name Chainlink as the chain oracle
templates.pons_fit: Required before most oracle based lending can list a Pons token, though new tokens rarely get a feed early.
templates.notes: Feed coverage for new long tail tokens is unlikely; always check the sequencer uptime feed on L2

templates.name: Compound III (Comet)
templates.description: Single borrowable asset market where several collateral tokens back loans of one base asset such as USDC, with absorb style liquidations.
templates.pons_fit: A forked Comet with USDG as base asset could add the Pons token as a capped collateral once a reliable price feed exists.
templates.notes: Change date has passed so forking is allowed under GPL; deployment and configuration scripts are involved

templates.name: Euler Vault Kit (EVK) and EVC
templates.description: Modular credit vault system where builders spin up ERC-4626 lending vaults with custom oracles and IRMs, linked through the Ethereum Vault Connector for cross collateral and looping.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1 (change date 2029-04-24, then GPL-2.0-or-later); EVC and periphery GPL-2.0
templates.audited: Yes, ChainSecurity, OpenZeppelin, Spearbit/Cantina, Certora and others
templates.robinhood_note: Chain 4663 is absent from the official euler-interfaces EulerChains.json list (Arbitrum 42161 present)
templates.pons_fit: An escrow vault could hold the Pons token as collateral for a USDG borrow vault, but that needs Euler to deploy on Robinhood first.
templates.notes: BUSL blocks commercial forks until 2029; use the deployed GenericFactory instead of copying code

templates.name: Fraxlend
templates.description: Permissionless pairwise lending where each pair is an ERC-4626 lending vault with its own oracle, rate model and maturity settings.
templates.audited: Yes, Trail of Bits and Frax internal reviews
templates.pons_fit: Fork and deploy a Pons token and USDG pair with a TWAP or Chainlink oracle as a permissive license alternative to BUSL protocols.
templates.notes: Permissive license makes forking easy; repo is older and less actively maintained, so re-audit any fork

templates.name: Morpho Blue (Morpho Markets V1)
templates.description: Immutable lending primitive where anyone can open an isolated market with one collateral asset, one loan asset, an oracle, an LLTV and a whitelisted interest rate model.
templates.audited: Yes, OpenZeppelin, Spearbit, Cantina competition, Certora formal verification (reports in repo audits folder)
templates.robinhood_note: Official morpho-org/sdks address registry lists Morpho Blue 0x9D53d5E3bd5E8d4Cbfa6DB1ca238AEA02E651010 for chain 4663; Robinhood Earn launched on Morpho at mainnet
templates.pons_fit: Open an isolated market that takes the Pons token as collateral to borrow USDG once a Chainlink or custom oracle exists for the token.
templates.notes: Market creation is permissionless but needs a sound oracle for long tail tokens, and the IRM and LLTV must already be enabled by governance

templates.name: Morpho Vault V2
templates.description: ERC-4626 vault framework with curator, allocator and sentinel roles that routes deposits through adapters into Morpho markets and other yield sources under configurable caps.
templates.audited: Yes, multiple firms (reports in repo audits folder)
templates.robinhood_note: Morpho SDK registry lists vaultV2Factory 0x0FBad98595b0186dA120E41f77C102beb49f803c on chain 4663; MetaMorpho V1.1 factory is not listed there
templates.pons_fit: Make a companion vault the creator fee recipient so USDG or ETH fees are deposited and lent out, with share yield going to a community treasury.
templates.notes: Curator role carries real risk management duty; on Robinhood use V2 factory since the MetaMorpho V1 factory is absent

templates.name: Silo V2 isolated markets
templates.description: Two asset isolated lending markets created from a factory, each pairing a token with a counterpart so risk stays contained to that pair.
templates.audited: Yes, multiple firms per Silo docs and repo
templates.robinhood_note: Official silo-core deployments file lists arbitrum_one, mainnet, sonic and others but no Robinhood entry
templates.pons_fit: A Pons token and USDG pair market would suit the isolated model once Silo deploys on Robinhood Chain.
templates.notes: Repo now labelled Silo V3 Core under BUSL until 2031 so commercial forking is not allowed

templates.name: Arcadia Accounts and Lending
templates.description: Margin accounts that hold concentrated liquidity positions and tokens as collateral and borrow from Arcadia lending pools for leveraged, auto rebalanced LP.
templates.robinhood_note: Official arcadia-finance mcp-server lists Robinhood (4663) as a supported chain; launch announced by @ArcadiaFi on Sept 7 2026
templates.pons_fit: Could hold leveraged LP positions in a Pons token pool if Arcadia whitelists the pair, which is unlikely early on.
templates.notes: Live on Base, Unichain, Optimism and Robinhood; change date passed so AGPL applies to forks

templates.name: Contango V2
templates.description: Builds leveraged long, short and looping positions by routing flash loans and swaps into existing money markets such as Aave, Morpho and Euler.
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Depends on underlying money markets listing the asset; BUSL blocks commercial forks until 2027

templates.name: DeFi Saver V3 recipes
templates.description: Action and recipe framework that chains protocol actions with flash loans for leverage, repay, boost and automated position management.
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Permissive license and modular actions; automation relies on off chain bots and per protocol actions

templates.name: Fluid Vaults and Liquidity Layer
templates.description: Shared liquidity layer feeding high LTV borrow vaults and smart debt and smart collateral DEX positions, designed for capital efficient looping.
templates.robinhood_note: Official deployments.md lists mainnet, arbitrum, base, polygon, plasma, bnb; no Robinhood entries
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Vault creation is governance gated; BUSL blocks forks until late 2027

templates.name: Gearbox V3 Credit Accounts
templates.description: Composable leverage through isolated credit accounts that borrow from passive pools and use allow listed adapters to enter DeFi strategies.
templates.audited: Yes, ChainSecurity, Sigma Prime, Consensys Diligence and others
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Gearbox Permissionless lets curators run their own markets via a market configurator; confirm onboarding terms

templates.name: Instadapp DSA and Connectors
templates.description: DeFi smart accounts that call protocol connectors in batched spells, a common base for one transaction leverage, deleverage and refinancing flows.
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Connector coverage per chain varies; core account contracts are a separate repo

templates.name: Lazy Summer Protocol (Fleet vaults)
templates.description: ERC-4626 fleet vaults that rebalance deposits across lending markets and yield sources using AI assisted keepers within governed risk limits.
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Fleet creation is governance controlled and BUSL blocks forks until 2028

templates.name: Notional Leveraged Vaults
templates.description: Reference strategy vault contracts that borrow fixed or variable rate debt from Notional to run leveraged LP and staking strategies.
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Tightly coupled to Notional V3 core, which is BUSL; check current Notional protocol status before building

templates.name: Bond Protocol fixed term auctioneers
templates.description: Permissionless bond markets where issuers sell payout tokens at a discount for quote tokens through sequential Dutch auction pricing, with fixed term or fixed expiry vesting.
templates.pons_fit: A companion could buy Pons tokens with USDG fees and sell them as discounted vested bonds for protocol owned liquidity.
templates.notes: With no creator allocation, bond payout tokens must be bought on market first; AGPL applies to forks

templates.name: Morpho Midnight
templates.description: Fixed rate, fixed maturity lending with permissionless immutable markets where makers post offers and positions behave like zero coupon bonds.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1 (change date earlier of 2030-05-01 or ENS record); interfaces, libraries, periphery GPL-2.0-or-later
templates.audited: Yes, reports in repo audits folder, Certora formal verification
templates.robinhood_note: One Morpho SDK registry lists a Midnight address on Robinhood and another does not, verify before use
templates.pons_fit: A fixed term market could let Pons token holders borrow USDG to a set maturity once a price ratifier oracle is configured.
templates.notes: New protocol, so integrate rather than fork given BUSL until 2030; offer and ratifier model is novel

templates.name: Notional V3
templates.description: Fixed and variable rate lending using fCash zero coupon instruments and per currency liquidity pools, with leveraged vault support.
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: BUSL until 2027 and new currencies need governance; verify protocol is still actively supported

templates.name: OpenZeppelin ERC4626
templates.description: Audited tokenized vault base with virtual share inflation protection, used to build yield, savings and term deposit vaults.
templates.audited: Yes, OpenZeppelin internal audits and external reviews
templates.robinhood_note: Library, deploy your own instance
templates.pons_fit: Base for a companion vault that receives creator fees and issues shares, which can plug into Pendle, Spectra or Morpho.
templates.notes: Library only; strategy logic and accounting are the builder's responsibility

templates.name: Pendle V2 yield tokenization
templates.description: Wraps yield bearing assets into SY, splits them into principal and yield tokens with a maturity, and trades them in a time decaying AMM.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1 LICENSE with change date 2023-07-01 passed (now GPL-2.0-or-later); source files GPL-3.0-or-later
templates.audited: Yes, six firms per repo README
templates.robinhood_note: Official repo has deployments/4663-core.json with marketFactoryV6 and router; Pendle announced Robinhood launch Sept 7 2026
templates.pons_fit: A companion ERC-4626 vault holding USDG creator fees could be wrapped as SY so holders trade fixed and variable yield on it.
templates.notes: Needs a yield bearing underlying and a custom SY adapter; UI listing is curated by Pendle

templates.name: Spectra principal and yield tokens
templates.description: Permissionless factory that tokenizes any ERC-4626 vault into principal and yield tokens and seeds a Curve pool for fixed rate trading.
templates.pons_fit: Any ERC-4626 companion vault funded by creator fees could get its own PT and YT market without needing permission.
templates.notes: Relies on Curve pools on the target chain; check whether Curve exists on Robinhood

templates.name: Term Finance Term Repos
templates.description: Fixed rate, fixed term collateralized borrowing settled through sealed bid auctions, modelled on tri party repo with repo tokens for lenders.
templates.audited: Yes, Sigma Prime, Dedaub, Runtime Verification, Certora formal verification
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: License forbids commercial use and derivatives, so no forking; Arbitrum was only planned per 2024 STEP application

templates.name: Yield Protocol V2 and YieldSpace
templates.description: fyToken zero coupon borrowing with a cauldron collateral ledger and YieldSpace AMM for fixed rate pricing up to maturity.
templates.robinhood_note: Protocol wound down in December 2023
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Team wound down in 2023 so code is unmaintained; useful as a GPL reference design only

templates.name: Balancer v3 vault and pool factories
templates.description: Shared vault with permissionless weighted, stable, LBP, Gyro and reCLAMM pool factories plus a hooks framework for custom pool logic.
templates.audited: Yes, Certora, Trail of Bits, Spearbit, Cantina
templates.robinhood_note: balancer-deployments address registry has an arbitrum file but no Robinhood Chain file
templates.pons_fit: An 80/20 token and USDG weighted pool could hold creator treasury liquidity, but only on Arbitrum today.
templates.notes: Boosted pools wrap ERC4626 yield tokens. Liquidity bootstrapping pools overlap with the Pons bonding curve role.

templates.name: Curve Stableswap-NG factory
templates.description: Vyper factory for permissionless stableswap pools of pegged assets, supporting rate oracle tokens, rebasing tokens and ERC4626 assets.
templates.license: Proprietary (Swiss Stake AG, all rights reserved, no reuse license)
templates.robinhood_note: No Robinhood entry found in Curve repos or docs
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Source published for reference only so forking is not allowed. Twocrypto-NG has the same license. Suits USDG and stock pegs.

templates.name: LFJ Liquidity Book (Trader Joe v2)
templates.description: Bin based AMM where each discrete price bin holds constant sum liquidity, giving zero slippage within a bin and fungible per bin shares.
templates.robinhood_note: No Robinhood deployment found
templates.pons_fit: Bin ladders could be forked on Robinhood for staged sell walls of the token, though effort is high.
templates.notes: MIT makes it the most permissive CL style AMM to fork. Repo last updated 2024.

templates.name: OpenZeppelin Uniswap Hooks
templates.description: Audited Solidity base contracts for v4 hooks covering dynamic fees, hook fees, custom curves, async swaps, anti-sandwich, limit orders and rehypothecation.
templates.robinhood_note: Library compiled into your own hook, deploy it against the Robinhood PoolManager yourself
templates.pons_fit: A BaseHookFee hook on an extra token pool could skim swap fees to a companion contract that also receives Pons creator fees.
templates.notes: Hook addresses must be mined for permission flags. Actively maintained, last commit October 2026.

templates.name: PancakeSwap Infinity (CL pools and hooks)
templates.description: Singleton vault with concentrated liquidity and bin pool managers that support hooks, closely mirroring the Uniswap v4 design.
templates.robinhood_note: PancakeSwap developer address page and repo config robinhood-mainnet.json list Vault 0x4F922d5B15e6691e0469663E4F5C4177f23c5FaF and CLPoolManager 0xeE04c68742e6Bf434bE8039580D2e89BBE55bc6f
templates.pons_fit: Create a second token pool on Robinhood with a custom hook, giving the launched token a venue outside Uniswap.
templates.notes: Only CL pool manager on Robinhood, bin pools not deployed there. GPL licensed so forking is allowed.

templates.name: Uniswap v2 constant product pools
templates.description: Minimal x times y equals k pair factory with fungible ERC-20 LP tokens and a router, widely forked and battle tested.
templates.robinhood_note: Uniswap blog of July 2 2026 states v2, v3, v4 and UniswapX are live on Robinhood Chain
templates.pons_fit: Full range token and WETH pair whose fungible LP tokens can be staked in a rewards contract funded by creator fees.
templates.notes: Solidity 0.5.16 code. Fungible LP tokens make it the easiest pool to pair with LP staking.

templates.name: Uniswap v3 concentrated liquidity
templates.description: Factory plus pool contracts for concentrated liquidity with fixed fee tiers, NFT positions via the periphery NonfungiblePositionManager.
templates.robinhood_note: Uniswap blog of July 2 2026 states v2, v3, v4 and UniswapX are live on Robinhood Chain, docs host a Robinhood v3 deployments page
templates.pons_fit: Add a concentrated token and USDG pool alongside the locked v4 pool to deepen liquidity for routers that still prefer v3.
templates.notes: Confirm exact Robinhood v3 factory address from Uniswap docs before integrating.

templates.name: Uniswap v4 hook template
templates.description: Foundry starter repo with an example counter hook, deployment scripts and a preconfigured local PoolManager test setup for building custom v4 hooks.
templates.robinhood_note: Template only, point scripts at the Robinhood v4 PoolManager to deploy
templates.pons_fit: Good scaffold for a hook that pairs the launched token with USDG in a secondary pool feeding fees to a companion contract.
templates.notes: Example code only, not production hardened. Pairs well with OpenZeppelin Uniswap Hooks.

templates.name: Uniswap v4 official hooks (WETH, wstETH, StablePair)
templates.description: Uniswap Labs maintained production hooks including a zero fee WETH wrap hook, wstETH wrap and routing hooks, and a dynamic fee stable pair hook.
templates.robinhood_note: Official README deployment tables list Ethereum, Arbitrum and others but not Robinhood Chain
templates.pons_fit: WETHHook style routing lets ETH denominated creator fee flows enter v4 pools without separate wrapping logic.
templates.notes: WETHHook is on Arbitrum, wstETH hooks Ethereum only. MIT source can be redeployed on Robinhood.

templates.name: Uniswap v4 pools (core and periphery)
templates.description: Singleton PoolManager where anyone initializes a pool with chosen fee, tick spacing and optional hook, with PositionManager handling LP positions.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1 core (change date 2027-06-15 or earlier, then MIT), periphery MIT
templates.audited: Yes, OpenZeppelin, Trail of Bits, Spearbit, Certora, ABDK
templates.robinhood_note: Official Uniswap v4 deployments list chain 4663 with PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951 and PositionManager 0x58daec3116aae6d93017baaea7749052e8a04fa7
templates.pons_fit: Pons graduates into a locked v4 pool here, so extra token pools, hooks and fee routing all live on the same PoolManager.
templates.notes: Using the deployed PoolManager is fine, forking core is BUSL restricted until the change date unless a Uniswap license grant applies.

templates.name: Arcadia accounts and LP asset managers
templates.description: Margin accounts and lending pools with automated rebalancers, compounders and yield claimers for Uniswap v3, v4 and Slipstream positions.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1 (accounts and lending change date 2026-07-08 passed, now AGPL-3.0-or-later; asset-managers BUSL)
templates.robinhood_note: tradingstrategy.ai lists ArcadiaV2 lending vaults on Robinhood Chain, asset manager addresses not independently verified
templates.pons_fit: Automate rebalancing and fee compounding of extra Uniswap v4 token positions on Robinhood.
templates.notes: asset-managers repo lacks a license file, SPDX says BUSL. Integrate rather than fork.

templates.name: Arrakis V2 vaults
templates.description: Factory deployed vaults holding multiple Uniswap v3 ranges with pluggable managers, used for protocol owned and market maker liquidity.
templates.robinhood_note: Ecosystem articles mention Arrakis on Robinhood Chain but no official address found, newer Arrakis Modular code is not public
templates.pons_fit: Manage protocol owned token liquidity on a v3 pool with a vault whose manager collects fees for a companion contract.
templates.notes: Arbitrum deployments in repo deployments/arbitrum. Arrakis Modular for v4 is closed source.

templates.name: Euler Earn
templates.description: Factory deployed ERC4626 aggregator that allocates deposits across Euler vaults and other ERC4626 strategies under curator controlled caps.
templates.audited: Yes, Certora, Sigma Prime, Pashov Audit Group
templates.robinhood_note: euler-interfaces registry lists eulerEarnFactory 0xB9B5d62B9fE9E1B505466e75817aB178A1D2ec9d on Arbitrum and no chain 4663 folder
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Underlying Euler Vault Kit is BUSL-1.1 until 2029-04-24, Earn itself is GPL.

templates.name: Gamma Hypervisor
templates.description: Fungible ERC-20 vault wrapping Uniswap v3 style base and limit positions, rebalanced by an operator to keep liquidity active.
templates.audited: Yes, ConsenSys Diligence, Bailsec, Arbitrary Execution
templates.robinhood_note: No Robinhood deployment found
templates.pons_fit: A forked hypervisor could manage a v3 token and USDG position, issuing LP shares that holders can stake.
templates.notes: Relies on an off chain rebalancing operator. v3 only, no v4 support in this repo.

templates.name: Lagoon vaults
templates.description: ERC-7540 async vault deployed from a factory, where a Safe managed curator settles deposits and redemptions against a NAV oracle.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1 (change date 2029-01-01 or earlier, then GPL-2.0-or-later)
templates.robinhood_note: Lagoon networks page lists Arbitrum factory 0x9de724b0efee0fba07fe21a16b9bf9bbb5204fb4 and no Robinhood factory
templates.pons_fit: A creator treasury Safe could run a Lagoon vault on Arbitrum, little fit on Robinhood for now.
templates.notes: Using the official factory is fine, forking the code is BUSL restricted.

templates.name: Solady ERC4626
templates.description: Gas optimized ERC4626 implementation in assembly heavy Solidity, with configurable decimal offset and virtual share handling.
templates.robinhood_note: Library, deploy your own instance
templates.pons_fit: Cheaper base for a token staking vault where creator fee buybacks accrue to share holders.
templates.notes: Solmate ERC4626 is an older alternative but AGPL-3.0-only, so Solady or OpenZeppelin are preferred for closed forks.

templates.name: Superform v2 core and SuperVaults
templates.description: ERC-7579 smart account executors and hooks that route deposits into ERC4626, ERC-7540 and other yield sources, with ledger based fee accounting.
templates.robinhood_note: Repo script/output/prod/4663/RH-latest.json lists prod SuperExecutor 0x9cC8EDCC41154aaFC74D261aD3D87140D21F6281 and SuperLedger 0x04916bB42564CdED96E10F55C059d65E4FCb1Be6
templates.pons_fit: Route USDG creator fees on Robinhood into curated yield sources through Superform hooks in one transaction.
templates.notes: Older superform-core v1 is BUSL, v2 is Apache-2.0. Verify Robinhood addresses on the explorer before use.

templates.name: Yearn V3 vaults and tokenized strategy
templates.description: Vyper multi strategy allocator vaults deployed from a factory, plus a Solidity tokenized strategy base that turns a single yield source into an ERC4626.
templates.robinhood_note: No Robinhood address in Yearn docs, README says factory can be deployed permissionlessly to new chains via CREATE2
templates.pons_fit: Companion contract could deposit USDG creator fees into a Yearn style vault and stream shares to token stakers.
templates.notes: Tokenized strategy lives in yearn/tokenized-strategy. AGPL obliges source disclosure for network use of modified code.

templates.name: Chainlink Data Streams
templates.description: Low-latency pull oracle where signed reports are fetched offchain and verified onchain through a verifier proxy, used by perps for execution prices.
templates.robinhood_note: Robinhood docs list verifier proxy 0xcE73c8ad08CBDEaCa6078BF0627C8fe0a9a536E7 on chain 4663
templates.pons_fit: Low, streams exist only for listed assets, not newly launched tokens.
templates.notes: Requires a Chainlink subscription and API credentials. Core dependency for any perps or options build on Robinhood Chain.

templates.name: Derive V2 (formerly Lyra)
templates.description: Portfolio-margined options and perps engine with subaccount NFTs and risk managers, settled from an offchain matching layer.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1 core, change date 2029-03-20 for code since Feb 2025 (older code GPL-3.0 since Nov 2025); matching repo AGPL-3.0
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Runs on its own Derive Chain, bridging from Arbitrum. BUSL blocks commercial forks of recent code.

templates.name: Gains Network gTrade
templates.description: Synthetic leveraged trading on crypto, FX and stocks with gToken vaults as counterparty, reachable through the official TypeScript SDK.
templates.license: SDK is MIT; current core contracts not published in the org
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Integrate only, no forkable contract repo found. Ostium shows the older v5 design is forkable.

templates.name: GMX V1 (GLP vault)
templates.description: Single multi-asset GLP pool acting as counterparty for leveraged spot-priced perpetual trades, with position router and keeper execution.
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Defunct. Exploited for about 42M USD in July 2025 and trading halted. Widely forked, but fork only with fixes and fresh audits.

templates.name: GMX V2 Synthetics (GM pools and GLV)
templates.description: Oracle-priced perpetuals and swaps backed by isolated GM liquidity pools, with GLV vaults that route LP capital across several GM markets.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1, change date the earlier of 31 Aug 2026 or an ENS-set date, converting to GPL-2.0-or-later; date has passed but confirm ENS record and per-version terms
templates.audited: Yes, ABDK, Certora, Dedaub, Guardian, Sherlock
templates.robinhood_note: Sept 2026 reporting lists v2.2c only on Arbitrum, Avalanche and MegaETH
templates.pons_fit: Low, listing a new market needs a deep oracle feed and keeper set that a fresh Pons token will not have.
templates.notes: v2.2b disabled Sept 14 2026, integrate against v2.2c addresses. Forking needs Chainlink Data Streams and keepers.

templates.name: Lighter zk perps contracts
templates.description: ZK rollup perps exchange whose onchain contracts hold USDG margin, verify batches and provide an escape hatch while matching runs offchain.
templates.license: BUSL-1.1, no additional use grant, change date 2029-01-01 to GPL-2.0-or-later; no commercial fork before then
templates.robinhood_note: ZkLighter proxy 0x94bab9693ba2f6358507effcbd372b0660afff9d on Robinhood Chain; official perps partner in Robinhood Wallet since July 2026
templates.pons_fit: Low, but a Robinhood Chain vault holding Pons fees in USDG could short on Lighter as its hedge leg.
templates.notes: BUSL blocks forking. Trades, funding and liquidations live offchain in the zk engine, only margin flows are onchain.

templates.name: Orderly Network EVM contracts
templates.description: Omnichain vault and ledger contracts behind a shared perps orderbook that lets builders launch white-label perp DEX front ends.
templates.robinhood_note: Orderly docs list Robinhood Chain mainnet vault 0x816f722424B49Cf1275cc86DA9840Fbd5a6167e9; live since Aug 2026
templates.pons_fit: A launched project could run a branded Orderly perps front end and earn builder fees, though the Pons token itself is not a margin asset.
templates.notes: Matching is offchain on Orderly infrastructure. Best no-code route to perps on Robinhood Chain today.

templates.name: Ostium V2
templates.description: RWA-focused perpetuals for stocks, FX and commodities using a shared USDC vault as counterparty, adapted from the Gains v5 design.
templates.pons_fit: Low, a fork could list Robinhood stock tokens with Chainlink feeds, but a Pons token is too thin to list as a market.
templates.notes: Closest MIT template for stock perps. Needs private price relays and keepers. Check Gains v5 upstream licensing as the README advises.

templates.name: Perennial V2
templates.description: Intent and oracle-settled perpetual markets where makers and takers share one market per payoff, plus Apache-licensed maker vaults.
templates.license: Mostly Apache-2.0, but Market.sol and MarketFactory.sol are BUSL-1.1 to block full redeployment
templates.pons_fit: Low, new markets need an oracle and maker liquidity that a fresh fixed-supply token lacks.
templates.notes: BUSL core blocks a commercial full fork. Vault and oracle packages are reusable. Repo activity slowed since 2025.

templates.name: Pyth Price Feeds (EVM SDK)
templates.description: Pull-based oracle interfaces where callers post signed price updates onchain before reading crypto, equity and FX prices.
templates.robinhood_note: Pyth contract address tables do not list chain 4663; only an unsourced social post claims a launch
templates.pons_fit: Low
templates.notes: Pyth Core requires API keys after the July 31 2026 upgrade. Robinhood docs name only Chainlink as the chain oracle.

templates.name: Synthetix V3 Perps Market
templates.description: Modular router-proxy system where pooled LP collateral backs cross-margin perpetual markets with async Pyth-settled orders.
templates.pons_fit: Low, the perps market needs pooled stablecoin collateral and oracle feeds a new token cannot supply.
templates.notes: Arbitrum V3 perps sunset in 2025 under SIP-416. Permissive license makes it the cleanest full-stack perps fork.

templates.name: Vertex Protocol contracts

templates.notes: Bonds and liveness must be tuned; disputes resolve via UMA DVM on Ethereum

templates.name: Aragon OSx with token voting plugin
templates.description: DAO framework where a factory deploys a DAO contract and installs permissioned plugins such as token voting, multisig and admin from a plugin repo.
templates.pons_fit: The DAO contract can be the creator fee recipient and the token voting plugin can wrap the existing Pons token for votes.
templates.notes: AGPL applies to modified forks; Robinhood needs an OSx framework deployment first

templates.name: Compound Governor
templates.description: Current Compound DAO governor built on OpenZeppelin upgradeable governance, succeeding GovernorBravo, with timelock execution and proposal guardian controls.
templates.robinhood_note: Template to deploy your own
templates.pons_fit: Fork a governor whose timelock receives creator fees, voting with a wrapped checkpoint version of the Pons token.
templates.notes: Same wrapper caveat as OZ Governor; Bravo style tooling is widely supported by Tally

templates.name: Hats Protocol
templates.description: Role registry where hats are revocable ERC-1155 roles in a tree, with eligibility and toggle modules that can gate authority on token holdings.
templates.audited: Yes, Trust Security and one other firm
templates.pons_fit: A balance based eligibility module could give Pons token holders roles such as signer or grant reviewer on the fee Safe.
templates.notes: Singleton contract at a deterministic address; Robinhood deployment not confirmed

templates.name: OpenZeppelin Governor, TimelockController and ERC20Votes
templates.description: Modular onchain governance with proposals, quorum, counting modules and timelocked execution, plus checkpointed vote tokens and ERC20Wrapper.
templates.audited: Yes, OpenZeppelin audits and Certora formal verification
templates.robinhood_note: Library, deploy your own instance
templates.pons_fit: Set the timelock as creator fee recipient and let holders wrap the fixed supply token into an ERC20Votes wrapper to govern spending.
templates.notes: Plain Pons ERC-20 lacks vote checkpoints, so a wrapper token is needed; Tally indexes these governors

templates.name: Snapshot X (sx-evm)
templates.description: Onchain voting spaces deployed from a proxy factory with pluggable voting, authentication, proposal validation and execution strategies such as Safe and timelock.
templates.pons_fit: A space with Safe execution strategy can direct the fee receiving Safe, using a votes wrapper or whitelist strategy for the token.
templates.notes: Plain ERC-20 balances are not safe for onchain voting; use a checkpointed wrapper

templates.name: Zodiac Reality Module (SafeSnap)
templates.description: Safe module that executes transactions approved by an offchain Snapshot vote once a Reality.eth oracle answer is finalized, giving trust minimized execution.
templates.pons_fit: Holders vote on Snapshot with plain token balances and approved spends execute from the fee receiving Safe.
templates.notes: Needs Reality.eth and a module proxy factory on Robinhood; arbitrator and bond settings matter

templates.name: Zodiac Roles Modifier
templates.description: Safe modifier that grants scoped permissions to addresses, limiting which contracts, functions and parameters each role may call.
templates.pons_fit: Lets a fee receiving Safe delegate narrow spending rights, such as buybacks only, to an operator or bot.
templates.notes: Permission configs are complex; misconfigured scopes can expose treasury funds
